name: The Good News According to Matthew

verses.text: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.
Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples
and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”
Jesus answered them, “\+w Go \+w and \+w tell \+w John \+w the \+w things \+w which \+w you hear \+w and see: *

\+w the \+w blind receive \+w their sight, \+w the \+w lame \+w walk \+w the \+w lepers \+w are \+w cleansed \+w the \+w deaf hear,* \+w the \+w dead \+w are \+w raised \+w up \+w and \+w the \+w poor \+w have \+w good \+w news \+w preached \+w to \+w them
\+w Blessed \+w is \+w he \+w who finds \+w no occasion \+w for \+w stumbling \+w in \+w me

As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “\+w What \+w did \+w you \+w go \+w out \+w into \+w the \+w wilderness \+w to \+w see \+w A \+w reed \+w shaken \+w by \+w the wind? *
\+w But \+w what \+w did \+w you \+w go \+w out \+w to \+w see \+w A \+w man \+w in \+w soft clothing? \+w Behold \+w those \+w who \+w wear \+w soft clothing \+w are \+w in \+w kings \+w houses *
\+w But \+w why \+w did \+w you \+w go \+w out \+w To \+w see \+w a \+w prophet \+w Yes \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w and much \+w more \+w than \+w a \+w prophet *

\+w For \+w this \+w is \+w he \+w of \+w whom \+w it \+w is \+w written ‘\+w Behold \+w I send \+w my messenger \+w before \+w your \+w face \+w who \+w will \+w prepare \+w your \+w way \+w before \+w you

Most \+w certainly \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w among \+w those \+w who \+w are \+w born \+w of \+w women \+w there \+w has \+w not \+w arisen anyone \+w greater \+w than \+w John \+w the Baptizer; \+w yet \+w he \+w who \+w is \+w least \+w in \+w the Kingdom \+w of \+w Heaven \+w is \+w greater \+w than \+w he *
\+w From \+w the \+w days \+w of \+w John \+w the Baptizer \+w until \+w now \+w the Kingdom \+w of \+w Heaven suffers violence, \+w and \+w the violent \+w take \+w it \+w by force.*
\+w For \+w all \+w the \+w prophets \+w and \+w the \+w law \+w prophesied \+w until \+w John *
\+w If \+w you \+w are \+w willing \+w to \+w receive \+w it \+w this \+w is \+w Elijah \+w who \+w is \+w to \+w come *
\+w He \+w who \+w has \+w ears \+w to hear, \+w let \+w him hear.*

“\+w But \+w to \+w what \+w shall \+w I \+w compare \+w this \+w generation \+w It \+w is \+w like \+w children \+w sitting \+w in \+w the marketplaces, \+w who \+w call \+w to \+w their \+w companions *
\+w and \+w say ‘\+w We played \+w the flute \+w for \+w you \+w and \+w you didn’t \+w dance \+w We mourned \+w for \+w you \+w and \+w you didn’t \+w lament *
\+w For \+w John \+w came \+w neither \+w eating \+w nor \+w drinking \+w and \+w they \+w say ‘\+w He \+w has \+w a \+w demon *

\+w The \+w Son \+w of \+w Man \+w came \+w eating \+w and \+w drinking \+w and \+w they \+w say ‘\+w Behold \+w a \+w gluttonous \+w man \+w and \+w a \+w drunkard \+w a \+w friend \+w of \+w tax \+w collectors \+w and sinners!’ \+w But \+w wisdom \+w is \+w justified \+w by \+w her \+w children
Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

“\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w Chorazin \+w Woe \+w to \+w you Bethsaida! \+w For \+w if \+w the \+w mighty \+w works \+w had \+w been \+w done \+w in \+w Tyre \+w and \+w Sidon \+w which \+w were \+w done \+w in \+w you \+w they \+w would \+w have \+w repented \+w long \+w ago \+w in \+w sackcloth \+w and \+w ashes *
\+w But \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w it \+w will \+w be \+w more tolerable \+w for \+w Tyre \+w and \+w Sidon \+w on \+w the \+w day \+w of \+w judgment \+w than \+w for \+w you *

\+w You \+w Capernaum \+w who \+w are \+w exalted \+w to \+w heaven \+w you \+w will \+w go \+w down \+w to Hades. * \+w For \+w if \+w the \+w mighty \+w works \+w had \+w been \+w done \+w in \+w Sodom \+w which \+w were \+w done \+w in \+w you \+w it \+w would \+w have \+w remained \+w until \+w today *
\+w But \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w that \+w it \+w will \+w be more tolerable \+w for \+w the \+w land \+w of \+w Sodom \+w on \+w the \+w day \+w of \+w judgment \+w than \+w for \+w you

At that time, Jesus answered, “\+w I \+w thank \+w you \+w Father \+w Lord \+w of \+w heaven \+w and \+w earth \+w that \+w you \+w hid \+w these \+w things \+w from \+w the \+w wise \+w and understanding, \+w and revealed \+w them \+w to \+w infants *
\+w Yes \+w Father \+w for \+w so \+w it \+w was \+w well-pleasing \+w in \+w your \+w sight *

\+w All \+w things \+w have \+w been \+w delivered \+w to \+w me \+w by \+w my \+w Father \+w No \+w one \+w knows \+w the \+w Son \+w except \+w the \+w Father \+w neither \+w does \+w anyone \+w know \+w the \+w Father \+w except \+w the \+w Son \+w and \+w he \+w to \+w whom \+w the \+w Son \+w desires \+w to reveal \+w him
“\+w Come \+w to \+w me \+w all \+w you \+w who \+w labor \+w and \+w are heavily \+w burdened \+w and \+w I \+w will \+w give \+w you rest. *

\+w Take \+w my \+w yoke \+w upon \+w you \+w and \+w learn \+w from \+w me \+w for \+w I \+w am \+w gentle \+w and \+w humble \+w in \+w heart \+w and \+w you \+w will \+w find \+w rest \+w for \+w your \+w souls *
\+w For \+w my \+w yoke \+w is \+w easy \+w and \+w my \+w burden \+w is \+w light
